candidate.text: The next Jev call IS sent (admission passes: 3 jev calls < max_jev_calls=30; known_jev_tokens=95000 < max_jev_tokens=100000, doubled from 50000 since worker_family="claude" per config.__post_init__; call/cost budgets fine). But it ends in failure: the response's usage check computes known_jev_tokens + usage["total_tokens"] = 95000+6000=101000 > max_jev_tokens(100000), so the post-response require raises MeshError code "jev_token_budget_exceeded", caught by the except(MeshError, jev.Failure) block, which sets event["error"]["code"] = "jev_token_budget_exceeded" (via _error_code). Since event["status"] != "ok" afterward, the final require(event["status"]=="ok", "provider_call_failed") then raises, so call() itself raises MeshError code "provider_call_failed".
